title: ACH Costs Are a Fraction of Check Costs for Businesses AFP Survey Shows
excerpt: Paper check 'an across-the-board median cost of between $2.01 and $4'; ACH 'median cost of initiating and receiving an ACH payment for all businesses to be between 26 cents and 50 cents.'
limitations: 2022 survey (AFP 2022 Payments Cost Benchmarking); B2B payers not DAF sponsors; medians exclude labour/exceptions per some readings

title: Increase pricing
excerpt: Next-day ACH origination $0.50; same-day ACH $2.00; check printing/mailing $3.00 per check (+$1.00 per extra page); wire $15.00; RTP $2.50. Positive pay and prenote not listed.
limitations: List price at access date; volume pricing may differ

title: Stripe pricing (Financial Connections; ACH; payouts)
excerpt: Financial Connections: '$1.50' per successful instant verification; micro-deposit verifications 'free'; balances $0.10; ownership $1.50 per successful API call; ACH Direct Debit 0.8% capped $5; ACH next-day payout $0.50; same-day $1.00.
limitations: Stripe is a payments facilitator; CNV-LEG-001 bars Unbound holding funds so only verification products are directly relevant

title: Print and mail pricing
excerpt: Checks 'Starting at $1.190' (Developer $0/month); 'Starting at $1.040' on Startup ($260/month) and Growth ($550/month); price covers print + postage.
limitations: 'Starting at' prices; check stock/MICR/positive-pay file handling may add cost

title: Your 'Not Enrolled for E-Pay' Status Is Costing You Donors
excerpt: '67% of Fidelity Charitable's 3 million grants were already distributed electronically'; nonprofits can receive electronic payments from partner DAF providers 'at no cost'; check 'arrives two to four weeks later'.
limitations: Secondary report of Fidelity data; no sponsor-side Disbursements price published

title: Form 990 series downloads
excerpt: Bulk 990-series e-file XML: 71 ZIP files across 2019-2026 plus annual CSV indexes; 'Some months may have more than one entry due to the size of the download.' No file sizes shown.
limitations: Corpus size not stated; storage sizing is ASSUMPTION

title: Exempt Organizations Business Master File Extract (EO BMF)
excerpt: 'The files are available in comma separated value (CSV) format'; divided by state and region; 'Updated data posting date: 11/10/2026'.
limitations: No fee shown (consistent with cost-register CST-D01); update cadence not stated on page

title: Amazon S3 pricing (and secondary pricing guides)
excerpt: AWS page: 'S3 GET requests from the S3 Standard storage class cost $0.0004 per 1,000 requests.' Secondary guides: S3 Standard us-east-1 $0.023/GB-month first 50 TB.
limitations: Storage table not extractable from AWS page; $0.023 taken from secondary guides

title: USPS recommends new prices for July
excerpt: Forever stamp 'from 78 cents to 82 cents'; metered 1-oz letter 74 to 78 cents; 'to take effect on July 12.'
limitations: Postage is one component of check print+mail prices (ECO-004) which may lag postage changes

title: Account Reconciliation Positive Pay disclosure
excerpt: Positive Pay Monthly Fee Per Account $50.00; ACH only $35.00 (via search result excerpt).
limitations: Read via search excerpt not full PDF; single bank

title: Business Banking Fee Schedule
excerpt: ACH Positive Pay Service $10.00 monthly per account; check positive pay $10 (via search result excerpt).
limitations: Read via search excerpt; single bank; per-item exception fees vary ($2-$7 at other banks)

title: Plaid pricing and billing
excerpt: Auth is a one-time fee product charged 'whenever the product is successfully added to an Item'; Identity Match is 'a Per-request flat fee product'; 'To view pricing, apply for Production access.'
limitations: Plaid prices are not public; third-party estimates ($1-2 per link) not used as fact

title: Cost per payment (worked example)
excerpt: Worked example operating cost check $5.71 vs ACH $1.67 (direct fees $1.75/$0.30; labour 6 vs 2 min at $31.67/h; exceptions 5% vs 2% at 30 min); 'Not a benchmark.'
